title: PAN Card Application Basics
summary: A PAN card is usually required for tax and financial records. The process is simple, but applicants should check the latest official requirement before submitting documents.

steps.title: Choose the correct application form
steps.detail: Use the official PAN application form and select the correct category for your status.

steps.title: Fill in the required details
steps.detail: Enter your personal information carefully and keep your full name, date of birth, and address consistent with your documents.

steps.title: Submit the document set
steps.detail: Attach the required identity and address proof documents and review the form before sending it.

steps.title: Pay the application fee if required
steps.detail: Check the current official fee before submission and keep the payment record for follow-up.

warnings.title: Check the latest fee and channel
warnings.message: Official fees and submission channels can change. Always confirm the current notice before making a payment.

warnings.title: Do not use fake personal data
warnings.message: Use only fictional or safe test examples in development. Real personal information should not be used in the sample flow.

disclaimer: This is a plain-language explanation and guidance helper, not legal, tax, or financial advice.
